name: compand by a logarithmic curve
mechanism: pass a signal through a logarithm-like curve before uniform quantisation so small amplitudes get fine steps and large ones coarse steps, and invert the curve on playback

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Mu-law algorithm' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossy compression algorithms: standard analog signal compression or companding algorithm
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'A-law algorithm': standard companding algorithm

requires: a curve shared by both sides (policy)
